subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default to user config, or keep delivery as an explicit per-launch `--deliver` choice?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces, and this request changes how users opt into provider delivery from TUI sessions.

options.title: Approve narrow config default
options.body: Add a single canonical TUI-owned delivery default with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI override behavior.

options.title: Keep launch-only delivery
options.body: Leave current documented behavior in place and close or defer the config-default request.

options.title: Design a settings flow first
options.body: Defer the config key until maintainers decide whether delivery should be a persistent TUI setting instead of a raw config field.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow config default
recommendation.body: Add a single canonical TUI-owned delivery default with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The original TUI surface and product/config direction are closest to the feature-introducer history for this behavior.
